releaseNotes:
## Changes

The highlights:

- Fix text encoding detection for ZIP archives on Android and our Homebrew platforms. (#3401)
- Improve support for LZH archives (#3394)

For everything else read the release notes. Enjoy!

## Full release notes

https://blog.easyrpg.org/2025/06/easyrpg-player-0-8-1-1-stun-patch-1/

## For Developers / Maintainers / Building

This is a minor patch release. Build against liblcf 0.8.1.

Minimum supported versions were changed from _very ancient_ to _a bit less ancient_: (#3391)

- CMake 3.18 (from 3.16)
- SDL 2.0.14 (from SDL 2.0.5)

Otherwise, there are no significant changes.

As a reminder:

- Autotools (``configure``) is still deprecated and will be removed in the next major release. Please migrate to CMake
- To opt in to SDL3 (the default is SDL2) invoke CMake with ``-DPLAYER_TARGET_PLATFORM=SDL3``
